conditional_assumptions.status: July31 fiscal-origin conditional research, October18 information; independent review pending. Not an exact July valuation or October target.

claim_allowance_rationale.reference: July other long-term liabilities excluding DTL and matched deferred compensation total215.654; fiscal2025 grossUTB173.734 plus0.9 interest/penalties is a historical overlapping reference. These amounts are not additive and not a proof of remaining settlement.
claim_allowance_rationale.status: Selected analyst settlement allowance. Adequacy is unverified; it is neither a measured liability balance nor a verified upper bound.

conditional_assumptions.claim_scope: The350 allowance covers residual opening non-operating uncertain-tax/acquisition obligations, pension deficits, legacy retention liabilities not paid through forecast costs, unmatched deferred-compensation, minority interests, and other non-operating contingencies. It excludes separately deducted current tax88.454, interest170.462 and debt10110.449. All references within the allowance are not further deductions.
conditional_assumptions.operating_overlap_exclusions: No deduction of the full837.594 payroll accrual,187.322 trade payables,196.766 other current accruals or215.654 noncurrentOther. Ordinary operating claims remain in operating costs/NWC. Operating FX hedges are included in operating cash assumptions;20.401 net derivative liability is a separate stress only if not already funded in operations. Full DTL850.250 is not separately deducted on top of cash-tax rates; no DTA credit95.515. Matched NQDC471.484 asset/liability is excluded symmetrically. Legacy restructuring64.9 is paid once in Q4 FCFF, not in the allowance or bridge.
conditional_assumptions.known_tax_accrual_policy: The88.454 opening current-tax accrual is deducted as an existing claim. Modeled noncash operating-capital investment excludes income taxes, and normalized forward cash taxes cover earnings after July. Do not schedule a second settlement of this opening accrual in forecast taxes.
conditional_assumptions.cash_policy: July unrestricted cash3606.286 minus operating reserve291.45 leaves3314.836 before haircut. Assume excess cash shares the reported rounded46% foreign mix; a10% haircut on that portion is a combined distribution-tax/availability valuation allowance, not a measured tax bill. Restricted cash4.490 excluded. No separate foreign-tax claim overlaps this haircut.
conditional_assumptions.award_policy: Assume prior October all-plan maximum RSUs4.318 and options1.154 persist at July after unobserved grants, settlements and forfeitures. This is explicitly conditional, not a factual roll-forward. ESPP1.0M assumes approximately two years of recent0.5M annual purchase volume remain across overlapping offerings; actual active rights unknown. Full-unit allocation is used without option/ESPP exercise proceeds, not instrument fair value. The assumed inventory may be incomplete.
conditional_assumptions.interval_warning: Analyst stress intervals only; not guaranteed bounds or probabilities. Litigation can exceed the range. Review passing arithmetic does not prove allowance adequacy or cohort completeness.
conditional_assumptions.post_origin_asr: The October5 ASR cash commitment1000, expected initial1.735M shares and residual forward are entirely excluded from July assets, units and future operating FCFF. It changes allocation after the origin. A later-date case must bridge actual payment, initial delivery, final settlement and every intervening cash/share movement together. No current-price-derived settlement estimate.

proxy_table_scope_conflict.treatment: Use the broader annual maximum-condition all-plan tables, not the narrower proxy total. acquired_conversion.performance_conversion: Continuing awards converted to Synopsys units; performance conditions removed and service vesting retained. Specified vested/director/departed-employee RSUs settled in merger consideration; do not count those as continuing unvested claims.
acquired_conversion.policy: Annual inventory is already converted into SNPS units. Do not multiply it by0.3399 or the award conversion ratio again. Full assumed legacy claims receive allocation once; neither639.7 nor130.963 nor508.7 is a second cash deduction. Acquisition consideration already funded before the origin.

future_new_grant_policy.base_rationale: 12% is near the recent SNPS grant-value/perimeter sensitivity12.04% and standalone Ansys RSU-only12.64%. It is below broad SNPS2023–24 gross proxies15.94%/15.38%. It is an analyst compensation budget, not a reported consolidated grant rate. Upside10% requires lower grant intensity; downside15% retains older grant pressure.
future_new_grant_policy.source_accounting_guidance: FY2027 accounting SBC960–980 and FY2030 ambition near8% do not establish the economic cost of future new grants. Do not simply use those accounting amounts as free owner cash.

stub_replacement.source: Direct Q4 FY2026 SBC guidance230–240, consistent with selected expense endpoints; SNPS-073 official Q3 results release. Do not subtract full-year/YTD figures to force inconsistent guidance.

legacy_recognition.method: Illustrative straight-line schedules only. Subtract and reverse equal legacy accounting recognition. No extra EV benefit or deduction. Exact award count uncertainty remains separately in allocation. Alternative1/1.9/3-year legacy schedules cancel before taxes.
legacy_recognition.future_grants: Post-July new grants remain an economic expense in every period and are not added again to future shares.
legacy_recognition.tax: No separate tax windfall from legacy settlements; normalized cash-tax rates remain assumptions.

compensation.rd_composition: For display only, allocate50% of the increase in new-grant cost versus v2 to R&D, close to FY2025 reported R&D share456.804/893.294=51.14% of SBC. Hold non-SBC total costs fixed; full grant charge reduces EBIT regardless of functional allocation. R&D and grants overlap, so do not sum or subtract them twice.

laterReviewNote.en: The original public v3 files retain their submitted/pending-review wording. The separate October 18 independent audit subsequently gave a qualified pass for explicit conditional July-origin research: 3,319 mechanical checks passed with no headline numeric correction. This does not certify award completeness, residual-claim adequacy, forecast economics, exact July equity, current-price comparison, app integration or publication. SNPS-V3-LABEL-01 is addressed in this consuming schema by labeling the FY2026 reconstructed EBIT as mixed-basis and keeping the fully grant-normalized reference separate; originals remain unchanged.
laterReviewNote.zh-Hans: 原始公开 v3 文件保留提交时的待复核措辞。另附的 10 月 18 日独立审计随后对明确标注七月基准日的条件性研究给予有保留通过：3,319 项机械检查通过，头条数值无需修正。这不证明奖励库存完整、剩余请求权预算充分或预测经济假设成立，也不批准精确七月股权价值、当前股价比较、应用集成或发布。本消费模式通过将 2026 财年重构 EBIT 明确标为混合口径，并另列全年新授予规范化参考值，落实 SNPS-V3-LABEL-01；原始文件不变。
